Walking the tree from the keyboard.

- With the tree focused, `Up` / `Down` move between rows, and a file you stop on opens after a short pause, so a held key does not open every file it passes.
- `Right` opens a folder, then goes into it. On a file it moves the focus into the page: a Markdown file at its first block, any other file so `Up` / `Down` scroll it.
- `Left` closes a folder, then goes up to the one holding it. From a file being read, `Left` gives the focus back to the tree at the row you left, and in Markdown `Right` comes back to the block you were on.
- `Space` opens the row's menu, walked with `Up` / `Down`, `Enter` and `Escape`. The focus comes back to the tree once the entry is done, including after the colour menu or the tag picker.

Install: download `docs-panel-0.6.3.vsix` below, then run `code --install-extension docs-panel-0.6.3.vsix`.
